limitations: Synthetic profiles are not a sample of real applicants.
Public role profiles are not active vacancies; fictional requirements are explicitly authored.
Labels are author judgments, not employer ATS ground truth or independently validated gold labels.

Only 36 anchor pairs have requirement labels; the other cross-pairs are unlabelled.
Once used for tuning, move this corpus to development and collect a fresh evaluation set.
